root_cause.text: During sound card unbind, after flushing delayed work, the PCM close triggered by `snd_card_disconnect_sync()` can schedule new delayed work (via `snd_soc_dapm_stream_stop()`), which then accesses DAPM widgets after they have been freed by `soc_remove_link_components()`.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message explicitly state: "the resulting PCM close path can call snd_soc_dapm_stream_stop() which schedules new delayed work ... Since this happens after the flush in snd_soc_unbind_card(), the new work is not caught. soc_remove_link_components() then frees DAPM widgets before this work fires, leading to the use-after-free." The fix adds a flush in `soc_cleanup_card_resources()` after `snd_card_disconnect_sync()` and before `soc_remove_link_dais()` / `soc_remove_link_components()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Flush all delayed work before removing DAIs and DAPM widgets during card cleanup to prevent use-after-free bugs.
intent_record.what: Added a call to snd_soc_flush_all_delayed_work(card) with a comment before removing DAIs and DAPM widgets in soc_cleanup_card_resources.
intent_record.how: During card cleanup, the function now ensures any pending delayed work is completed before tearing down DAIs and DAPM widgets, preventing use-after-free and race conditions.
